messages.subject: R/qtlcharts: interactive graphics for QTL data
messages.subject_clean: R/qtlcharts: interactive graphics for QTL data
messages.body_plain:
I'm developing a new R package, R/qtlcharts, for interactive graphics for QTL data.

It's still at an early stage, but I think it's at the point were aspects might be useful to people. I'd be glad for feedback.

  http://kbroman.github.io/qtlcharts/

Karl Broman
http://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman
